document.title: Interest Income
document.issued_by: bank, credit union, brokerage or other payer of interest

recipient.name: Recipient.Name
recipient.note: The extractor's own field names, measured on stored reads (engagement 16, 2026-10-02). Read by `Owner.of` to say whose figure this is (spec 079 FR-035); the TIN's last four only.

boxes.label: Interest income
boxes.notes: Recipient instruction: 'Shows taxable interest paid to you during the calendar year by the payer. This does not include interest shown in box 3.' Box 5 is inside this figure.

boxes.label: Early withdrawal penalty
boxes.notes: An ADJUSTMENT to income, not a reduction of box 1. 'You may deduct this amount to figure your adjusted gross income on your income tax return.'

boxes.label: Interest on U.S. Savings Bonds and Treasury obligations
boxes.notes: 'This may or may not all be taxable... This interest is exempt from state and local income taxes. This interest is not included in box 1.' Separate from box 1, and the amount from which the Form 8815 education exclusion on Schedule B line 3 is computed.

boxes.label: Federal income tax withheld
boxes.notes: Backup withholding. 'Include this amount on your income tax return as tax withheld.'

boxes.label: Investment expenses
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1. 'Any amount shown is your share of investment expenses of a single-class REMIC. This amount is included in box 1. Note: This amount is not deductible.' It routes nowhere.

boxes.label: Foreign tax paid
boxes.notes: 'You may be able to claim this tax as a deduction or a credit on your Form 1040 or 1040-SR.' A taxpayer election.

boxes.label: Foreign country or U.S. territory
boxes.notes: Identifies the jurisdiction for box 6. No federal route of its own.

boxes.label: Tax-exempt interest
boxes.notes: Federally tax-exempt interest. Box 9 is inside this figure.

boxes.label: Specified private activity bond interest
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 8, but an AMT preference with its own destination. 'Shows tax-exempt interest subject to the alternative minimum tax. This amount is included in box 8. See the Instructions for Form 6251.'

boxes.label: Market discount
boxes.notes: NOT inside box 1. Reported only where you made the section 1278(b) election. 'Market discount on a tax-exempt security is includible in taxable income as interest income.'

boxes.label: Bond premium
boxes.notes: REDUCES BOX 1. Premium amortization on a taxable covered security other than a U.S. Treasury obligation. Enters Schedule B as a subtraction labelled 'ABP Adjustment'. Where the payer already reported interest net of premium, no further reduction is permitted.

boxes.label: Bond premium on Treasury obligations
boxes.notes: REDUCES BOX 3, by the same 'ABP Adjustment' mechanism.

boxes.label: Bond premium on tax-exempt bond
boxes.notes: REDUCES BOX 8 - that is, it reduces the tax-exempt interest reported on Form 1040 line 2a. 'If the amount in box 13 is greater than the amount of interest paid on the tax-exempt covered security, the excess is a nondeductible loss.'

boxes.label: Tax-exempt and tax credit bond CUSIP no.
boxes.notes: Identification only. No route.

boxes.label: State
boxes.notes: State reporting. No federal route.

boxes.label: State identification no.
boxes.notes: State reporting. No federal route.

boxes.label: State tax withheld
boxes.notes: State reporting. No federal route. Feeds the Schedule A state and local income tax deduction, which is outside this scope.

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed above the issuer's block on every copy. A corrected form replaces one furnished earlier; its figures are the ones to use, never counted beside the earlier form's.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed on Copy A (the issuer's filing copy) and the state copy; the recipient's Copy B does not print it.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. An account or other unique number the issuer assigned; identification only, never a figure.

boxes.label: FATCA filing requirement
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. The issuer reports this account under chapter 4; the recipient may also have to file Form 8938. Moves no figure.

boxes.label: Payer’s RTN (optional)
boxes.notes: The payer's routing transit number, printed beside the payer's TIN. Identification only.

document.notes: Continuous-use form. The revision in force for TY2024 and TY2025 is Rev. January 2024; https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/f1099int--2025.pdf does not exist. Boxes 11, 12 and 13 are ADJUSTMENTS that reduce boxes 1, 3 and 8 respectively; boxes 2 and 10 are separate amounts that route on their own; box 5 is a breakout inside box 1 with no destination at all.
